name: emoji-test
description: Phase A #1 driving-emoji probe: a single, steady ~35 mph (15.6 m/s) run west out of downtown Miami along the Dolphin Expressway (SR-836), Valhalla-snapped to real roads. Deliberately built to Life360's activity thresholds - above the ~15 mph walk/drive split, well below the 80 mph speeding flag, >1.5 mi, ~6 min sustained, no trailing stop - so the ONLY variable being tested is whether the car emoji appears on a physically still phone. Limited-access expressway = few sharp turns, so the speed stays flat (no corner dips) and it reads as clean highway driving. Run with Life360's Motion & Fitness permission toggled OFF to test the GPS-only-fallback hypothesis (docs/research/activity-emoji-coremotion.md).
